name: StudySolo Glass Design System

components.name: Glass Button
components.keyInsightSeed: White in dark, ink in light — the primary button is the one opaque moment in a translucent world.

components.name: Glass Input Field
components.keyInsightSeed: Inputs are shallow glass at rest and deepen on focus — the interface leans toward attention.

components.name: Glass Panel
components.keyInsightSeed: Depth comes from blur tiers and one blurred layer per nesting level — not from borders.

components.name: Mac Window
components.keyInsightSeed: A Mac window is glass with three honest pixels: red, yellow, green — everything else stays quiet.

components.name: Mac Menu Bar & Menus
components.keyInsightSeed: Menus are the densest glass: small rows, exact 28px rhythm, one tinted wash for hover.

components.name: Glass Tab Bar & Segmented Control
components.keyInsightSeed: Active tab rises toward the user; the segmented thumb is a little white pill floating in a glass track.

crossCuttingPatterns: Glass six-pack on every surface: translucent fill + hairline border + inset top highlight + backdrop blur/saturate + ambient shadow + continuous corner
Single blurred layer per nesting level; inner nested surfaces use fill-only (performance invariant)
Dark default is warm charcoal; light tints are misty aqua and warm cream, switchable via [data-tint]
macOS rhythm: 28px menu bar, 44px window title bar, 28px menu rows, traffic lights 12px
Motion: 120-250ms, emphasized decelerate, spring thumb; scale 0.97 press; everything respects prefers-reduced-motion
